elliptic_axis — 2D features op

• Data kinds: region → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "elliptic_axis", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: elliptic_axis (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Returns the ratio (aspect ratio) of the major to minor axis of the equivalent ellipse (the ellipse with matching moment of inertia) of the region. Computed from `skimage.measure.regionprops's axis_major_length/axis_minor_length`, then divided by 10 to bring it roughly into the [0,1] scale (this is not true normalization, so it can exceed 1 for very elongated regions). a and b are unused.
